title: You can learn cross-country skiing without waiting for snow
alt: Twin ski tracks running through snow between bare birch trees under a blue sky.

posts.facebook:
Cross-country skiing takes you along forest trails rather than down a slope. In Scotland you can learn on an all-weather track, and in the US many Nordic centres sell a beginner package with ski hire and a trail pass. Start with classic technique.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-cross-country-skiing/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
